intro.text_02: Practical finance support for management reporting, FP&A, profitability analysis, forecasting, cash flow and financial control. Work can be scoped as a project or recurring support, with clear deliverables.

deliverables.text_02: Defined outputs that help owners and finance teams understand results, anticipate cash needs and improve financial control.
deliverables.text_03: Monthly P&L and KPI reporting, budget-versus-actual analysis and concise commentary on financial performance and key variances.
deliverables.text_04: Budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario analysis and cash flow projections, with assumptions and key drivers made explicit.
deliverables.text_05: Customer and project profitability, margin analysis, pricing drivers and reviews of the cost structure.
deliverables.text_06: Month-end closing support, balance sheet reconciliations and practical improvements to financial controls.

finance_support.text_02: Support for business owners and management through one-off projects, recurring monthly reporting and finance support, or scheduled advisory and controllership engagements.
finance_support.text_03: Monthly reporting packs, KPI analysis and financial performance commentary.
finance_support.text_04: Budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario analysis and cash flow projections.
finance_support.text_05: Customer and project margins, cost structure reviews and profitability analysis.
finance_support.text_07: Engage Tellen Finance for a specific project or ongoing financial support, with the scope, deliverables and fees agreed upfront.
finance_support.item_01: Monthly management reporting and budget-versus-actual analysis
finance_support.item_02: FP&A: budgets, forecasts, scenarios and cash flow
finance_support.item_03: Customer, project and margin profitability analysis
finance_support.item_04: Month-end closing and balance sheet reconciliations
finance_support.item_05: Financial control improvements and practical financial analysis
finance_support.item_06: Scheduled financial sparring for owners and management
finance_support.text_08: €110/hour. Project and recurring engagements are scoped and priced upfront.

technical_accounting.text_02: Specialist, project-based IFRS and Dutch GAAP advice for complex transactions and reporting requirements. From Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS conversions to technical accounting papers, we agree the scope, deliverables and fee upfront.
technical_accounting.item_01: IFRS and Dutch GAAP assessments for revenue recognition, leases, provisions and complex contracts
technical_accounting.item_02: Dutch GAAP-to-IFRS conversions: gap analyses, opening balances, adjustment journals and comparatives
technical_accounting.item_03: Accounting implications of acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, goodwill and consolidation
technical_accounting.item_04: Technical accounting position papers, policy and disclosure reviews, and local-to-group reporting schedules

contact.heading_01: Need clearer financial reporting or stronger analysis?
contact.text_01: We agree the commercial question, deliverables and timetable before starting. For IFRS conversions or accounting standards advice, see our separate Technical Accounting service.
